chunks.text: Baltor vendor policy requires supplier reviews every 90 days. SharePoint access must be reviewed before contractor onboarding. The current escalation threshold is $25,000 as of 2026-05-31. Northstar Staffing acquired Harbor Temps in 2022, then Harbor Temps merged with Lakeside Workforce in 2023. A 2026 supplier portal export says CareShift Partners is independently owned, so ownership claims require a source date and refresh before current use. According to https://example.com/source, the policy owner is Security Operations.
